title: How many underage patients were examined during the course of the three-yea
question:
How many underage patients were examined during the course of the three-year period from 1990 to 1993?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: underage patients refers to year(Birthday) < 18; three-year period from 1990 to 1993 refers to year(`Examination Date`) between '1990' and '1993'

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON e.XCL_001 = p.XCL_058
WHERE strftime('%Y', e.XCL_002) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', e.XCL_002) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.XCL_060) AS INTEGER)) < 18
